people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
translations.bsb: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God.”
translations.kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
